recipe.title: Spaghetti and Meatballs
recipe.description: Who says you need meat to make spaghetti and meatballs? You'll find two plant-based meatball recipes below - one made with mushrooms and the other with a ground meat substitute. Both are delicious!
ingredients: Vegan Meatballs ( or Plant-Based Ground Meatballs)
instructions: Mix the spaghetti and zucchini noodles and portion into 4 bowls. Top with 2 to 3 meatballs per bowl, generous scoops of marinara, basil, and drizzles of olive oil. Season to taste with more salt and pepper, garnish with parsley, and serve.
